notes.title: Motel and Furnishings
notes.content:
Changelist:
- New motel where you can rent a room (300 AC for 500 in game days)
- Online shop where you can buy furnishings
- Place bought furnishings in your room

notes.title: Arel is now open!
notes.content:
- Freely explore the first portion of Arel
- Day/night cycle in sync for everyone around the world
- A day in game lasts for 20 minutes in real life (14 minutes of day and 6 minutes of night)
- Economy system
- Added a interaction tip and key when looking interactable objects

notes.title: Arel
notes.content:
Changelist:
- Introducing Arel
- Added a slider to adjust the field of view (FOV)
- First raw character customization
- Fixed a problem related to VR headsets

notes.title: Open the door!
notes.content:
Changelist:
- Fixed the mispelled "Participate" word
- Added the kitchen
- Added the living room

notes.title: Secret new game mechanic
notes.content:
Change List:
- New puzzle to solve to reveal a new game mechanic.
- New map to discover.
- Improved physics stability.
- Added a keymapping list that you can show by pressing the TAB key.
- Added a graphic settings menu. You can open it by pressing the F1 key.
- Added a slider in the graphic settings menu to control the Motion Blur amount.
- Much more to discover... <3
